rows.answer_text: Visakoivu Oy holds a valid qualification under the F-Gas Regulation (F-kaasuasetuksen mukainen patevyys) for refrigeration and air-conditioning equipment, valid until 31 January 2028.

Visakoivu Oy has completed multiple reference projects exceeding this threshold, including a EUR 1,650,000 property maintenance framework agreement for Jarviseudun hyvinvointialue covering five health centres.
Visakoivu Oy has also completed a EUR 1,120,000 school-property HVAC maintenance framework agreement for Keski-Vaaran kaupunki, which independently satisfies this higher threshold.
Visakoivu Oy's equity ratio in its most recent financial statements was 35.2%, above the required 20% minimum.

Visakoivu Oy will operate an annual visit calendar covering all four properties listed in Section 2, agreed with the contracting authority at contract start and reviewed annually. Each routine visit follows a standard task list appropriate to the system being serviced, as detailed in the responses to Section 4 and Liite A below. Completion of each visit is confirmed to the contracting authority through a signed visit report listing the tasks carried out, any findings, and any follow-up actions required.

Visakoivu Oy operates a standby (paivystys) arrangement covering evenings, weekends and public holidays, staffed by on-call technicians from its LVI, electrical and refrigeration teams. Fault reports are acknowledged promptly, with response times broken down by fault category as described in the response below.

Visakoivu Oy's personnel are briefed on the contracting authority's access-control and site-security procedures before starting work at any property, and comply with the specific safeguarding and visitor-management procedures in place at the school and day-care premises, including sign-in requirements and restrictions on working during periods when children are present. Subcontracted staff receive the same briefing before being granted site access.

Visakoivu Oy holds electrical contracting rights (Sahkourakointioikeudet, luokka S1) and arranges the periodic statutory inspection of electrical installations at each property in accordance with the applicable inspection intervals, using its own qualified electrical personnel.

Visakoivu Oy holds NMSB 74210:2015 environmental management system certification, and operates its waste segregation, hazardous-substance handling and spill-prevention procedures across all works under that system.

Visakoivu Oy will include a site-specific occupational safety plan covering all four properties listed in Section 2, addressing task-specific hazards, permit-to-work procedures, and site induction requirements for its own and subcontracted personnel.

Visakoivu Oy proposes an annual visual inspection of the roof, facade and windows at each property, supplemented by a more detailed condition survey every three years, with findings recorded in the same visit-reporting system described in the response to Section 4.1.

Visakoivu Oy proposes response times differentiated by fault category: safety-critical faults (such as loss of heating in occupied premises or fire-system faults) receive an on-site response outside normal working hours under the standby arrangement described in the response to Section 4.2; other reactive faults are attended during the next working day; non-urgent faults are scheduled into the next routine visit.

Visakoivu Oy requires personnel working on site, including subcontracted staff, to hold the occupational safety card (tyoturvallisuuskortti) and the trade-specific certificates relevant to their discipline; electrical work is carried out only by personnel qualified under the company's Sahkourakointioikeudet, and refrigeration and air-conditioning work only by personnel covered by the company's F-Gas qualification.
Visakoivu Oy proposes that the contract price be adjusted annually using an appropriate published cost index for building maintenance services, applied at each anniversary of the contract start date.
All prices in Visakoivu Oy's tender are quoted in euros, as required.
Visakoivu Oy accepts the contractual penalty applied where the agreed service level under Section 4 is not met, as set out in the draft contract and Liite B.
Visakoivu Oy proposes monthly invoicing, issued as e-invoices in the Finvoice format, itemised by property.
Visakoivu Oy will enclose CVs of the key personnel proposed for delivery of this contract, drawn from its LVI, electrical, building automation and property maintenance teams.
Visakoivu Oy will complete and submit the Tender Form provided as Liite 1 together with this tender.
Visakoivu Oy quotes all prices on the required basis of EUR per square metre per year (EUR/m2/vuosi), as set out in Section 7.1.
This tender is submitted as a single PDF file and is not password-protected.
All prices in this tender are quoted exclusive of value-added tax, in euros, as required.
This tender document uses a minimum font size of 11pt throughout.
This tender is drafted in Finnish, as required.

Visakoivu Oy's HVAC (LVI) maintenance programme covers quarterly inspection of air-handling units at each property, annual cleaning of ductwork in the kitchen and food-preparation areas at Jarvimaan yhtenaiskoulu and paivakoti Tuulentupa, and a documented log of measurements taken at each visit, retained for the contracting authority's inspection.

Visakoivu Oy maintains stock of common spare parts for the installed building systems through its regional supplier network; parts not held in stock are sourced with a standard delivery time of five working days, or sooner where the fault affects a safety-critical system.

Visakoivu Oy's fire-protection maintenance regime covers periodic testing of smoke detection systems, functional testing of fire dampers, and inspection and testing of emergency lighting at each property, in accordance with the applicable regulatory intervals for each system type.

Visakoivu Oy confirms that lift maintenance will be carried out in accordance with the applicable regulatory inspection regime, and arranges statutory periodic lift inspections through an accredited inspection body at the intervals required by that regime.
Visakoivu Oy accepts the retention terms set out in the draft contract enclosed with the tender documents.

Visakoivu Oy will enclose a certificate of insurance confirming its liability cover of EUR 2,000,000, together with confirmation of its separate professional indemnity insurance, consistent with its statements elsewhere in this tender.
Visakoivu Oy will complete and submit the Reference Form provided as Liite 2, listing the reference projects relied upon under Section 3.
Visakoivu Oy will enclose a certificate from its pension insurance provider confirming that its pension insurance payments (elakevakuutusmaksut) are up to date.

general_sections.cover_letter: Visakoivu Oy is pleased to submit this tender in response to Jarvimaan kunta's invitation to tender for the framework agreement for technical property maintenance services (JMK-TEK-2026/09).
general_sections.company_overview: Visakoivu Oy is a Jyvaskyla-based technical and property services company founded in 1994, providing LVI, electrical, building automation and property maintenance services to public and private clients across Central Finland.
